_comment: Triibe rate card — single source of truth for what we pitch. All values in cents (USD). Used by pricing.js + draft.openai.js + leads promote endpoint. Riley's quotes — Cooper $4k/reel, Charlie $4.5k/reel + breakdown.

cooper._note: Story rate TBD. Floor is $1,500 — anything lower needs Riley's explicit OK.

charlie._note: Floor matches UGC rate — minimum acceptable Charlie deal.

brian._note: Brian Wallack — 705k IG / 502k TikTok. Per Brian's own rules: $1.5K Reel floor (cross-posted IG + TT + FB), $500 UGC fallback with full usage rights (he'll put on trial reels + tag), $350 song promo floor. NEVER product-only / no-pay. Long-term deals with Perfect Sport + Gymshark — any pitch in those categories surfaces as EXCLUSIVITY CLASH on the pill. bcc_email: Brian wants to be BCC'd on every outbound email — set his personal email here (replace placeholder).

exclusivity_policy._note: Push for zero. If brand insists, accept up to 30 days same-category. Surface anything 90+ as a redline for Riley to decide.

recurring_policy.ask_phrase: Open to one-off, but love to explore a structured recurring partnership — say 3–6 months at X/mo. Worth running one as a test first?
recurring_policy._note: Ask at the start of every new pitch. If brand says no → run ONE test video → reassess. Don't push hard on first decline.
